display.title: Episode 333: The Island of Treasures (Yud-Beis Tammuz)
display.summary_short: Six days before Yud-Beis Tammuz, Uncle Yossi tells of the Frierdiker Rebbe's imprisonment and release, a family visits Studio 604, and a shipwrecked man becomes king of an island of treasures.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on 6 Tammuz 5748, six days before Yud-Beis Tammuz. Uncle Yossi tells how in 1927 the Frierdiker Rebbe, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Schneerson, was imprisoned in Russia for teaching Torah to children and was freed on his birthday, the 12th of Tammuz, and how his mesiras nefesh led to yeshivos around the world and to Tzivos Hashem itself, since the Jewish child was always at the top of his list. After the Hakochainik march, a family of young siblings comes to Studio 604 to say the Shema and the Twelve Pesukim in memory of their grandfather. Story time, based on the Mishnah that this world is a hallway before the World to Come, tells of Yisroel, the lone survivor of a shipwreck, whom the people of an island crown king. He spends the whole royal treasury beautifying the island, only to learn that he must leave in rags when the next castaway arrives. The island is this world, the treasures are mitzvos, and we must send them ahead. The show ends with advice for summer vacation: learn Torah, daven and give tzedakah every day, and pack a siddur, Chumash and pushka.
display.lesson: This world is a hallway to the World to Come: use your time here to store up Torah and mitzvos, the treasures you will take with you.

date.note: Consistent with the audio: 'today is Vav Tammuz', Yud-Beis Tammuz 'this coming Monday'.

advisories.note: The Frierdiker Rebbe is jailed in Soviet Russia for teaching Torah, and his life is in danger.
